engine.reciprocal: soft (portable table model of the hardware RCPPS)

contract.input_layout: frame-major float32, little-endian, 513 values per frame
contract.output_layout: frame-major float32, little-endian, 1026 values per frame

exactness.criterion: bitwise equality of every expected output value

sets.name: quiet-speech
sets.description: Quiet voiced speech: harmonic comb with a three-formant envelope, syllable gating and a -40 dB level; 40 frames.

sequence.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(20261020) (PCG64), draw order: one standard_normal() per frame for the level
sequence.formula: f0 = 115 + 30*sin(2*pi*t/40) Hz; 40 harmonics with amplitude k**-0.8 and a 24 Hz Gaussian width; formants (520,110,1.00), (1480,190,0.62), (2520,280,0.36); amplitude = 10**(level_db/20), level_db = -40 + 6*sin(2*pi*t/13) + 2*N(0,1); gate 1.0 for t%10 < 7 else 0.12; power = A^2*((0.04+formant)*(0.02+comb)+1e-6)+1e-9; feature = ln(power)
sequence.note: Bins are 15.625 Hz apart (16 kHz / 1024); bin 512 is Nyquist.

sets.name: steady-noise
sets.description: Stationary noise: -3*ln(1+f/1000) tilt, a slow overall level, and independent per-bin texture; 40 frames.

sequence.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(20261021) (PCG64), draw order: 40 level samples, then 40*513 texture samples

sets.name: extreme-amplitude
sets.description: Extreme amplitude: the engine clamp sequence (scales 1..1000, full-scale frames every 9th frame); 40 frames.

sequence.formula: base[t,k] = N(0,1); scale = [1,30,300,3,1000,10][t % 6]; feature = base*scale; every 9th frame is the constant 500.0
